description: Responsible for building and maintaining the server-side logic, database interaction, and APIs that power web applications.
Focuses on designing, training, and deploying machine learning models to solve real-world problems.
Develops responsive and accessible user interfaces that provide seamless experiences across platforms.

Architect roles require planning large-scale UI architecture, optimizing performance, and leading frontend engineering strategy. Candidates must be experts in scalable design patterns and JS frameworks.
Analysts must extract insights from raw data, build dashboards, and support product decisions. Strong statistical thinking and SQL fluency are core expectations.
